verdict.rationale: three.js exposes a fully documented, versioned public JavaScript API (WebGLRenderer/WebGPURenderer, GLTFLoader, controls, TSL nodes) with extensive docs, examples, migration guides, and even an llms.txt tailored for AI consumption, which AI-native users/agents can programmatically drive. missing for 10: no formal OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec (probe shows 404s), no independent hands-on evidence of an AI agent successfully driving the API end-to-end, and community feedback notes some friction (missing loaders, type mismatches) that adds real-world caveats.
